space.method.sources: Appointments and referrals recorded in the platform by verified organisations (no estimate, no external data).
space.method.unmet: Referrals to which the receiving organisation answered “no capacity” or “outside our scope”.
space.method.limits: Only requests made through the platform are counted; a municipality appears only with at least 3 verified organisations; any value below 5 is hidden, and another value in the same column is hidden too when it would be the only hidden one; totals add up published values only.
space.method.periods: Complete calendar quarters only, without overlap (no month, year or free period: two nested periods would make it possible to recover a hidden value).
